info.title: IDPGitOps — F-002 Management plane arbitration
info.description: Two surfaces, reconstructed from code. Inbound: the metrics endpoint this feature actually serves — the only HTTP route the survey found in the whole repository [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/bootstrap/bootstrap.go:54]. Outbound: the blob-lease operations the controller performs through the Azure SDK, which are described here as operations rather than as a hand-written REST contract, since the code calls a client library and never composes the request itself. Shapes are $ref'd from schemas.json.

get.summary: Prometheus exposition for the lease controller
get.description: Served by the shared bootstrap helper, which every binary calls [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/bootstrap/bootstrap.go:52]. The lease controller publishes the last-successful-renew timestamp through it [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/bloblease/runner.go:164]. Exposition format, so no JSON schema is declared.

x-outbound-operations.description: Not HTTP paths this feature serves — lease operations it performs against Azure Storage through the SDK client.

acquire.note: Takes the configured term; conflict means another cluster holds it.

renew.note: Called when the renewal interval has elapsed.

release.note: Called on drain and on a preference change; a missing lease is treated as success.

break.note: Operator path only, via the CLI.

setPreferredCluster.note: Operator path only, written before a failback.
